diagnosis: The customer's data export job has been running for nine hours, exceeding the expected duration for a job of its size (4 GB). According to KB guidance, jobs under 10 GB should finish within an hour, and a job running for more than six hours is considered stalled.
reply: Your data export job EXP-40128 has been running longer than expected. Jobs of 4 GB typically complete within an hour. You may want to check the job status and consider cancelling and resubmitting it if it continues to run for an extended period.
